description: Make cycle-tokens reconstruction orchestrator-session-aware so post-respawn cycles stop under-counting orchTokens to 0

userStories.title: Stamp orchestrator session id on cycle-tokens events and reset the baseline at session boundaries
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need per-cycle orchTokens accounting to reset its telescoping baseline at an orchestrator-session boundary so that the first several cycles after an orchestrator respawn record their real token delta instead of flooring to 0 until the new transcript cumulative overtakes the old accumulated baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: CycleTokensEventDetail (src/supervisor/events.ts:375-383) gains an optional `orchSessionId?: string` field, documented in the surrounding doc comment as the orchestrator session uuid the event was recorded under; legacy events omit it. [oracle: grep -q 'orchSessionId' src/supervisor/events.ts]

recordCycleTokens stamps the current orchestrator session uuid onto every emitted cycle-tokens event, resolved via a new injectable reader (default resolves `.claude/<ORCH_SESSION_MARKER>` from cwd, trimmed, null when absent/empty) that mirrors the defaultReadOrchTranscript / defaultReadEventLog DI pattern in journal.ts:357-378; the marker path is not re-derived by hand (reuse ORCH_SESSION_MARKER from src/tmux/session.ts). [oracle: grep -q 'ORCH_SESSION_MARKER' src/commands/journal.ts]

reconstructPriorOrchCumulative is session-aware during replay: when two consecutive cycle-tokens events carry different `orchSessionId` values (a session boundary), the accumulated baseline resets to a fresh telescoping sum for the new session instead of continuing to add old-session deltas across the boundary. [oracle: bun test test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts]

At record time, when the current orchestrator session uuid differs from the trailing (most recent) cycle-tokens event's orchSessionId, priorOrchCumulative is treated as 0 so the FIRST cycle of a fresh orchestrator session records its full current transcript cumulative as the delta rather than flooring to 0 (replay alone cannot detect this because the new session has no event in the log yet on its first cycle). [oracle: bun test test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts]

Backward compatibility is byte-for-byte: cycle-tokens events with no orchSessionId (and legacy events with orchTokensMode absent) retain today's exact behavior; the session-boundary reset engages only once events carry the id, mirroring the orchTokensMode legacy-vs-delta split. The existing single-cycle floor test (journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts:473-504) and the monotonic-chain test (506-543) remain green unchanged. [oracle: bun test test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts]

A new test reproduces the CAM-333 multi-cycle under-count: prior-session baseline large (e.g. 5000), new session cumulative starts small and grows across at least 3 cycles; it asserts each post-reset cycle records the correct positive delta (NOT floored to 0). [oracle: grep -q 'orchSessionId' test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single cohesive fix, 3 files. FILES: src/supervisor/events.ts (add orchSessionId to CycleTokensEventDetail 375-383), src/commands/journal.ts (recordCycleTokens 523-568 + reconstructPriorOrchCumulative 450-473 + a new default reader beside defaultReadOrchTranscript/defaultReadEventLog at 357-378 and a new optional field on RecordCycleTokensOptions 476-502), test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts. TWO reset triggers required (both, not one): (a) replay-time id-change between consecutive events resets the telescoping baseline; (b) record-time current-session-id != trailing-event-id treats priorOrchCumulative as 0. Implementing only (a) leaves the first post-reset cycle still under-counting. GOTCHAS: the session uuid is ALREADY on disk at .claude/.cam-orch-session (ORCH_SESSION_MARKER, src/tmux/session.ts:508) and ALREADY read indirectly by orchestratorTranscriptPath (src/transcript/usage.ts:249-261) -- surface it via a NEW injectable reader, do NOT re-derive the path or invent a new disk-read convention. Do NOT repurpose WorkerEvent.uuid (it is the literal 'cycle-close' string for these events, journal.ts:564); add orchSessionId to the detail, not the envelope. delta mode: detail.orchTokens is a per-cycle DELTA (orchTokensMode='delta'); the reconstructed baseline is a telescoping SUM of deltas, so a boundary reset means starting a FRESH telescoping sum for the new session, not zeroing a stored cumulative. Downstream consumers (src/stats/tokens.ts:186 foldCycleTokens, src/commands/dashboard.ts:604, src/stats/split-advisory.ts) treat recorded orchTokens as authoritative and never recompute -- the fix must be correct at record time. Mirror the CAM-328 orchTokensMode legacy/delta precedent for the compat split. No ADR (reversible, no genuine alternative). PATTERNS: grep scripts/cam/patterns.md for the CAM-328/CAM-131 cycle-tokens bullets (lines ~292, ~833, ~835) before coding; append a new bullet documenting the session-boundary reset once done.
